content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I uploaded a program from a [product_name] device ([article_no]). However, when I try to download the program from my PC to another [product_name] device with a different [article_no], [product_name] software ([version_no]) displays an error dialog, as shown in the attached file. My computer is running Windows XP Professional SP2.
Hi, Please update your [product_name] software by going to Help > Update Center and downloading updates via the internet. Select the corresponding device version to match your hardware. Regards,

That's unusual. The hardware versions on my devices differ, but the software version is the same. There aren't any additional software updates available. However, the total number of hardware versions matches. Refer to the attached image for comparison.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter compatibility problems when transferring a program between different hardware versions of a [product_name] device using the same software version. An error message appears, even though both systems use identical software and no updates are available, causing confusion about hardware compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to transfer programs easily and have them work across various hardware versions of a [product_name] device when using the same software.
